exposure: deaths in the first week of life
cohort: Neonates admitted to the neonatal high care unit at New Somerset Hospital in Cape Town, South Africa, between 2011 and 2018 (excluding 2014).
finding: The study observed a decreasing trend in neonatal mortality, primarily driven by a reduction in deaths due to prematurity, potentially attributed to advances in respiratory care for preterm infants.
gest_age: Median gestational age of neonatal deaths: 29 weeks (IQR: 25-38 weeks)
birth_weight: Median birth weight of neonatal deaths: 1,140 grams (IQR: 790-2,420 grams)
